caseStudies.title: Circular Quay Precinct Renewal
caseStudies.summary: Master planning, commercial advisory, and procurement strategy for Australia's premier harbourfront transit hub.
caseStudies.description: Circular Quay is the international gateway to Sydney, welcoming millions of visitors and daily commuters. Bombheq Partners provided strategic advisory and transaction guidance to modernise the multimodal transport interchange, integrating ferry wharves, heavy rail, light rail, and heritage assets into a cohesive, world-class civic precinct.
keyOutcomes: Multimodal transit interchange optimisation across ferry, rail, and pedestrian corridors
Innovative commercial transaction structure protecting heritage harbor assets
Seamless alignment across state agencies, commercial lessees, and maritime authorities

faqs.question: How does Bombheq Partners structure cabinet-level infrastructure business cases and statutory frameworks?
faqs.answer: We combine rigorous engineering feasibility with Treasury-aligned economic appraisal to craft defensible Final Business Cases (FBC). Our partners work directly with sponsoring departments to define service need, evaluate multimodal corridor options, quantify wider economic benefits (WEBs), and establish statutory planning pathways that withstand Gateway assurance reviews.
keyTakeaways: Full alignment with Infrastructure Australia and State Treasury Assurance Frameworks
Integrated engineering constructability, cost-risk P50/P90 modelling, and benefit-cost ratio (BCR) validation
Early statutory corridor preservation and multi-agency governance charters

faqs.question: How do you determine the optimal procurement model between Construct-Only, D&C, Collaborative Alliances, and PPPs?
faqs.answer: Delivery model selection is driven by our structured Multi-Criteria Risk & Market Appetite Assessment. Rather than defaulting to rigid templates, we analyze geotechnical uncertainty, brownfield operational interfaces, balance-sheet constraints, and Tier-1 contractor capacity to package projects into bankable, high-competition contracts.
keyTakeaways: Bespoke risk allocation matrices calibrated to current contractor market appetite
Incentivized Target Outturn Cost (TOC) and painshare/gainshare regime design for Alliances
End-to-end transaction management from Market Sounding and EOI through RFT evaluation and Financial Close

faqs.question: What does 'Senior-Led Coalface Advisory' mean during live project execution and contract administration?
faqs.answer: Unlike large pyramid consultancies that delegate delivery after contract award, Bombheq Partners embeds experienced Principals and Directors directly into your project executive team. We establish early-warning commercial telemetry, administer complex interface deeds, and resolve emerging technical variations before they crystallize into formal claims.
keyTakeaways: Direct Principal and Partner accountability across every phase of delivery
Live interface governance between civil tunneling, stations, and rail/energy systems packages
Proactive variation assessment, schedule forensics, and independent payment certification

faqs.question: How do Geotechnical Baseline Reports (GBRs) and interface agreements protect sponsors on mega-projects?
faqs.answer: Subsurface conditions and multi-contractor interfaces represent the highest sources of cost overruns on major rail, tunnel, and pumped-hydro programs. Our engineering specialists author clear, contractual Geotechnical Baseline Reports and Interface Coordination Deeds that establish unambiguous physical and schedule baselines for all delivery partners.
keyTakeaways: Clear contractual demarcation of foreseeable vs. unforeseeable ground conditions
Elimination of duplicate contingency pricing in contractor tender submissions
Binding milestone handover protocols between civil works and systems integration contractors

faqs.question: How do you integrate decarbonisation, Scope 3 embodied carbon, and clean energy transition goals into infrastructure programs?
faqs.answer: Backed by our affiliation with the global Ricardo network, we embed quantifiable decarbonisation targets into both upfront policy and binding procurement KPIs. From Renewable Energy Zone (REZ) transmission structuring to zero-emission transport fleet transitions and low-carbon concrete/steel specifications, we turn net-zero policy into bankable commercial reality.
keyTakeaways: Lifecycle carbon baselining (PAS 2080) integrated into tender evaluation weightings
Commercial structuring for Long-Term Energy Service Agreements (LTESA) and utility-scale BESS
Access to Ricardo's global environmental and clean-energy engineering specialists across 20+ countries

faqs.question: How do your Dispute Avoidance Boards (DAB), forensic delay analysis, and Expert Witness engagements work?
faqs.answer: When commercial differences arise, our court-appointed specialists provide independent, forensic analysis of critical-path delay, disruption, and quantum valuation. We serve on standing Dispute Avoidance Boards to resolve issues contemporaneously on site, and provide objective Expert Witness testimony in adjudication (SOPA), arbitration, and Supreme Court proceedings.
keyTakeaways: Forensic critical-path retrospective delay and productivity loss modeling
Standing Dispute Avoidance Board (DAB) chairing and independent peer review
Strict independence and probity standards for arbitral tribunals and superior courts

faqs.question: What is the typical consulting process and timeline for engaging Bombheq Partners on a new mandate?
faqs.answer: We operate with rapid mobilization and zero bureaucratic friction. Following an initial confidential scoping briefing with a Managing Partner, we conduct a targeted 48-hour conflict and probity clearance, issue a tailored methodology and senior team charter, and can mobilize embedded specialists or panel advisors within 5 to 10 business days.
keyTakeaways: Step 1: Confidential Partner Discovery & Mandate Scoping (24–48 hours)
Step 2: Probity Clearance, Commercial Charter & Deliverable Roadmap
Step 3: Rapid Senior Team Mobilization via Government Panels or Direct Engagement
